name: Mort Morris-Goodall
features: fair skin, dark hair parted at the side, light eyes, narrow face, neat moustache, slim build, mild courteous expression
bio: Mortimer Morris-Goodall started racing Aston Martins at Brooklands in 1929, bought the ex-works LM7 and took it to Le Mans in 1933, the first of ten starts there. He founded the Aston Martin Owners Club in 1935, ran Donald Healey’s competition department from 1950, and was Jaguar’s team manager when the C-Type won Le Mans in 1953.
